projectile.description: A small glowing yellow-white energy bolt. Bright core (#FFEE55) with soft white center. Slightly elongated shape suggesting motion. Pixel art, no outline, additive blending friendly.

death_sparkle.description: Golden mana particle burst. 3-frame sequence: bright flash (#FFEE55), expanding ring of golden sparkles with tiny equipment fragments, fading golden motes. Pixel art, no outline, additive blending friendly.
